title: EvalSuite
description: A suite of scenarios for deterministic, reproducible evaluation of agentic workflows (side-by-side, shadow, single, and synthetic runs).

suite_name.description: A unique, human-readable name for this suite.

id.description: Unique identifier for this scenario within its suite.

mode.description: side-by-side: compare two candidate versions. shadow: run a candidate against real input with no side effects. single: evaluate one candidate in isolation. synthetic: run against a labeled/synthetic input.

input.description: The scenario's input: either a raw prompt string or a structured payload.

expected.description: An optional expected output or reference used by deterministic checks.

type.description: deterministic: a seeded, reproducible step. agentic: a step that invokes an LLM-driven agent and may be non-deterministic.

seed.description: A seed for reproducible deterministic stages.

tool_mocks.description: Per-adapter mock/replay configuration, keyed by adapter id. Each entry's `mode` selects the adapter's behavior (see EVALS_SANDBOX_API.md); other keys are adapter-specific extras such as a recorded `response` override.

threshold.description: Minimum judge score (0-1) required for the scenario to pass.
